column1: # Nodalia Launcher: the Nodalia apps (context = app id) and the launcher chrome.

column2: Install, update and open the Nodalia apps from one place.
column3: 在同一個地方安裝、更新並開啟 Nodalia 應用程式。

column2: Use the desktop's own window controls
column3: 使用桌面自帶的視窗控制項

column2: The word processor that stays out of your way.
Letters, reports and books in a fast native editor. It opens and saves DOCX and keeps your layout intact.
column3: 在快速的原生編輯器中撰寫信件、報告與書籍。可開啟並儲存 DOCX，並完整保留你的版面。

column2: Formulas, charts and large tables in a native app, with XLSX files that round-trip.
column3: 在原生應用程式中處理公式、圖表與大型表格，XLSX 檔案可無損往返。

column2: Build and present decks in a fast native app, and open and save PPTX files.
column3: 在快速的原生應用程式中製作並放映投影片，並可開啟及儲存 PPTX 檔案。

column2: Read, organize and protect your PDFs.
column3: 閱讀、整理並保護你的 PDF。

column2: View, annotate, fill, merge and sign PDF files, all on your own computer.
column3: 檢視、註解、填寫、合併並簽署 PDF 檔案，全部在你自己的電腦上完成。

column2: Your mail, calendar and contacts in one place.
column3: 郵件、行事曆與聯絡人，盡在一處。

column2: A native client for IMAP, POP3 and JMAP accounts, with mail rendered safely and your passwords kept in the system keyring.
column3: 支援 IMAP、POP3 與 JMAP 帳號的原生用戶端，郵件安全呈現，密碼保存在系統鑰匙圈中。

column2: Tasks, milestones and progress for your team.
column3: 為你的團隊提供任務、里程碑與進度。

column2: Plan projects, track tasks and see progress on a server you run yourself, with end-to-end encryption.
column3: 在你自己架設的伺服器上規劃專案、追蹤任務並查看進度，支援端對端加密。

column2: Team chat on your own server
column3: 在你自己的伺服器上進行團隊聊天

column2: Team chat on a server you run yourself.
column3: 在你自己架設的伺服器上進行團隊聊天。

column2: Workspaces, channels, threads and direct messages with end-to-end encryption, in a native desktop app.
column3: 工作區、頻道、討論串與私訊，支援端對端加密，運行於原生桌面應用程式中。

column2: The image editor you already know how to use.
column3: 你早已會用的影像編輯器。

column2: Layers, masks, adjustment layers, layer styles, type and brushes in a native app, with PSD files that open and save.

column2: Paths, shapes, type and effects for logos and illustrations, with SVG and PDF in and out.
column3: 用於標誌與插畫的路徑、形狀、文字與特效，支援 SVG 與 PDF 的匯入與匯出。

column2: Lay out magazines, books and posters with precise typography and print-ready PDF export.
column3: 以精確的排版與可直接印刷的 PDF 匯出來編排雜誌、書籍與海報。
相片圖庫與 RAW 顯像

column2: Your photo library and raw developer.
column3: 你的相片庫與 RAW 沖洗工具。

column2: Organize photos and develop raw files without ever touching the originals.
column3: 整理相片並沖洗 RAW 檔案，絕不動到原始檔案。

column2: Cut, grade and mix video on a fast native timeline.
column3: 在快速的原生時間軸上剪輯、調色並混音影片。

column2: Animate layers, shapes and text with keyframes, expressions and effects.
column3: 以關鍵影格、運算式與特效為圖層、形狀與文字製作動畫。

column2: Draw, tween and animate on a timeline, then export to video, GIF or image sequences.
column3: 在時間軸上繪製、補間並製作動畫，再匯出成影片、GIF 或影像序列。

column2: Frames with auto layout, components, styles and clickable prototypes, with live collaboration.
column3: 具備自動版面配置的畫框、元件、樣式與可點擊的原型，並支援即時協作。

column2: Build games from scenes and nodes, script them and export them, from one editor with physics, rendering and audio built in.
column3: 用場景和節點建構遊戲，撰寫腳本並匯出，一個編輯器即可完成，內建物理、算圖和音訊。

column2: Precise 2D drafting and parametric drawing, with DXF and DWG files.
column3: 精確的 2D 繪圖與參數式繪製，支援 DXF 與 DWG 檔案。

column2: Sketch, constrain and extrude solid parts with a feature timeline and a kernel written in Rust.
column3: 繪製草圖、加入約束並拉伸實體零件，配備特徵時間軸與以 Rust 撰寫的核心。

column2: Fluid simulation, from geometry to results.
column3: 流體模擬，從幾何到結果。

column2: Set up, run and inspect CFD simulations in one desktop app with its own solver engine.
column3: 在單一桌面應用程式中設定、執行並檢視 CFD 模擬，內建自有求解引擎。
電子電路，從電路圖到模擬。

column2: Design electronic circuits and see how they behave, in a native app that is part of Nodalia Engineering.
column3: 設計電子電路並觀察其行為，這是一款隸屬於 Nodalia Engineering 的原生應用程式。

column2: Work out the numbers behind an engineering project in a fast native app that is part of Nodalia Engineering.
column3: 在隸屬於 Nodalia Engineering 的快速原生應用程式中，算出工程專案背後的數字。

column2: A fast native interface for Apple Music with gapless playback and controls in your system's media panel.
column3: 針對 Apple Music 的快速原生介面，支援無縫播放，並可從系統媒體面板控制。

column2: A fast, private web browser that comes with Nodalix.
column3: 隨 Nodalix 一同提供的快速、私密網頁瀏覽器。
快速的原生程式碼編輯器。

column2: Edit code in any language with syntax highlighting, language-server diagnostics, projects and search, all in a native app written in Rust.
column3: 以語法醒目提示、語言伺服器診斷、專案和搜尋編輯任何語言的程式碼，全部在一款以 Rust 撰寫的原生應用程式中完成。
